title: Why Is Life?
description: A philosophical and deeply questioning personal essay on why life exists, the meanings we create, and what the Qur'an says about purpose and faith.
deck: We spend our lives searching for meaning. But have we understood what we are trying to give meaning to?
heroAlt: An atmospheric original illustration of unanswered questions beneath a vast sky, reflecting on existence, faith and the search for meaning.
heroCaption: Questions about why we exist do not always end when we discover what we live for.
